items.headline: G20 Finance Ministers Gather in North Carolina Amid Trade Tensions and Economic Pressure
items.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent hosted financial leaders from the world's largest economies in Asheville on Monday to address global economic growth, mounting debt, and trade friction. The summit takes place as the United States introduces new secondary financial sanctions and navigates ongoing trade disputes with key international partners.

items.headline: NASA Launches Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope on SpaceX Rocket to Study Dark Energy and Exoplanets
items.summary: NASA successfully launched its new flagship Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket from Florida to explore dark energy, dark matter, and distant planets [1.3.7]. The observatory is traveling to an orbit one million miles from Earth, where its wide-view imaging capability will allow it to survey the cosmos roughly 1,000 times faster than the Hubble Space Telescope.

items.headline: Lionel Richie Hospitalized After St. Louis Concert
items.summary: Legendary singer Lionel Richie checked into an intensive care unit in St. Louis for precautionary testing following a concert performance over the weekend. The 77-year-old musician completed his final song while seated due to reported dehydration, raising fresh health concerns during his nationwide tour.
